column1: # Hand-checked fixes for the most common words, applied by build_vocab.py.
# Wiktionary describes function words by their grammar ("Short form of the first-person singular pronoun…") and a
# frequency list cannot tell homographs apart (French "est" is "is", not "east"), so the top words are checked by hand.
# language<TAB>word (the lemma, without article)<TAB>meaning to show, or "-" to leave the word out
# [<TAB>part of speech: use only this entry of the word, e.g. pas as the adverb "not", not the noun "step"]
# [<TAB>written form, when the article cannot be worked out: i soldi]
